description: Read a range of pages out of a file attached to a note. read_note lists what a note has and how many pages each one is; this is how to read them. Use it after search_attachment to read around a match, or to work through a document a stretch at a time. Requires note_id.

file.description: The attachment's filename, exactly as it is written in the block holding that file's text.

from_page.description: The first page to read. A PDF's pages are numbered as the document numbers them. A file with no pages, such as a Word document, is divided into numbered sections of about 3000 characters instead.

note_id.description: Which note the file is attached to, as returned by search_notes or list_notes. Ignored in the app's own assistant, where the note is the one already open.

to_page.description: The last page to read. Omit it to read the one page. A long range comes back cut off after about 20,000 characters, saying where it stopped, so ask for the next range rather than for everything at once.

name: scratchpad_read_attachment
title: Read attachment
